# Whispers for Little Ear

date: 2026-11-25

Short phrases for the game «Little Ear» (`/game/whisper/`). The tone is gentle and quiet, with no microphone and no user-supplied text.

Quieter. Little Ear is already breathing more calmly.

Listen to how fur listens to a voice.

I'm here. I'm only whispering.

The left ear hears rain, the right one — footsteps.

Don't hurry. The night isn't over yet.

The word settled like a palm.

Even silence here knows how to listen.

Let the loud parts stay beyond the wall.

Sleep, Little Ear. I'll read a little longer.

A sound is a sound for a reason: it should be heard, not read.

Aesthetic: indie folk. To listen to: Leonard Cohen.

Nobody feeds the poor fellow, but the sign below reads: «He stands of his own free will».
